title: OrderItem Save with valid questions returns success
description: Verify that OrderItem Save action persists questions correctly and returns QuestionsSuccess=true in response body when user has proper permissions.
preconditions: User is logged in with OrderItem save permissions
Work request exists in editable state
At least one checklist question is configured

manual_steps.action: Fill out checklist questions with valid answers and click Save
manual_steps.expected_result: Questions are saved successfully and QuestionsSuccess flag is true in server response
manual_steps.notes: This is a critical test due to silent failure risk - always check response body for QuestionsSuccess=true

manual_steps.action: Verify the saved answers persist when navigating back to the checklist step
manual_steps.expected_result: Previously saved answers are displayed correctly in form fields
manual_steps.notes: Data persistence verification is essential for workflow integrity

title: OrderItem Save without proper permissions returns error
description: Verify that OrderItem Save action is blocked when user lacks CanSaveOrderItemItems permission, preventing unauthorized workflow advancement.
preconditions: User is logged in but lacks CanSaveOrderItemItems permission
Work request exists with checklist steps

manual_steps.action: Attempt to fill out checklist questions and click Save without proper permissions
manual_steps.expected_result: Save operation is blocked with appropriate permission error message
manual_steps.notes: Critical security test - unauthorized users must not be able to advance workflows

manual_steps.action: Verify no data changes were persisted despite the save attempt
manual_steps.expected_result: Checklist remains in original state with no unauthorized modifications
manual_steps.notes: Ensure permission check prevents any data persistence

title: SaveProposalQuestions - Successful Save with Valid Questions
description: Verify that proposal questions are saved successfully when valid question data is provided, returning success indicators and updated categories.
preconditions: User is logged in with Orders module access
Work request exists in Proposal stage with associated checklist step
Valid questions are configured for the checklist step

manual_steps.action: Navigate to Orders module and open an existing work request in Proposal stage
manual_steps.expected_result: Work request details page loads with checklist step visible
manual_steps.notes: Ensure the work request has a checklist step with questions configured

manual_steps.action: Fill out all questions in the checklist step with valid responses and click Save
manual_steps.expected_result: Questions are saved successfully. Response body contains QuestionsSuccess: true and QuestionsError: false
manual_steps.notes: Must check response body JSON, not just HTTP status - known silent failure pattern

manual_steps.action: Verify the UpdatedCategories field is populated in the response
manual_steps.expected_result: UpdatedCategories array contains the current categories for the work request
manual_steps.notes: Categories should reflect any changes made by saving the questions

review_note: UI element names for checklist save button and response verification need confirmation from actual EXAMPLE interface

title: SaveProposalQuestions - Permission Denied for Unauthorized User
description: Verify that users without CanSaveProposal permission cannot save proposal questions and receive appropriate error response.
preconditions: User is logged in without CanSaveProposal permission token
Work request exists in Proposal stage with checklist step

manual_steps.action: Login with a user account that does NOT have CanSaveProposal permission
manual_steps.expected_result: User can view Orders module but cannot edit proposals
manual_steps.notes: Use smoke_readonly_user or similar restricted account

manual_steps.action: Navigate to a work request in Proposal stage and attempt to save checklist questions
manual_steps.expected_result: Save operation fails with permission error. QuestionsSuccess: false in response body
manual_steps.notes: System should enforce permission at controller level before processing

review_note: Need to confirm exact permission error response format and UI behavior for unauthorized save attempts

title: SaveProposalQuestions - Handle Missing or Invalid Question Data
description: Verify system handles missing question data gracefully and returns appropriate error indicators without causing exceptions.
preconditions: User is logged in with CanSaveProposal permission
Work request exists with checklist step containing required questions

manual_steps.action: Navigate to checklist step with required questions but leave mandatory questions blank
manual_steps.expected_result: Checklist step form loads with required question fields visible
manual_steps.notes: Identify which questions are marked as mandatory

manual_steps.action: Click Save without filling required questions
manual_steps.expected_result: Save fails gracefully. QuestionsSuccess: false and QuestionsError: true in response body
manual_steps.notes: Should not cause server error - must handle validation gracefully

manual_steps.action: Fill required questions with valid data and save
manual_steps.expected_result: Save succeeds. QuestionsSuccess: true and QuestionsError: false in response
manual_steps.notes: Verify recovery path works after fixing validation errors
